heroBody: Explore materials, shape your space, and see it come to life. Your next home starts here.
kitchenDescription: A kitchen that fits your everyday.
orbitHint: Drag to orbit · pinch to zoom · Shift+drag or two fingers to pan
selectCabinet: Tap a cabinet to edit it.
fitError: This arrangement does not fit. Check room dimensions, openings, or available space.
noModules: There is no room for the selected layout.
priceDisclaimer: Indicative price. The final offer is confirmed after measuring and choosing materials.
exportError: The export could not be created. Please try again.
materialTitle: Small changes. A whole new feeling.
materialBody: Find the combination that feels like you.
performanceHelp: Lower shadows and resolution for smoother interaction.
resetHelp: Clears furniture drafts and A/B alternatives for the active brand.
setupHelp: Make the showroom yours. Changes are saved only when you choose an action.
invalidBrand: Check the brand name, folder name, colors, and logo.
pinNotice: The PIN is a demo convenience, not secure authentication.
brandLoadError: The brand could not be loaded. Please check its files.
invalidLink: This design link is invalid or incompatible. Your saved design has been preserved.
storageError: Device storage is unavailable. You can continue and export your work.
webglError: 3D graphics are unavailable on this device. Try another supported device.
sharedBrandNote: Basic branding travels with the link. Deploy the brand folder to include your custom logo.
optionalDetails: Optional · these details are excluded from design links
showroomHint: Tap a front to open it · Drag to look around · Two fingers to pan
imageUnavailable: The preview image is unavailable. Your configuration and estimate are included.
illustrativeFinish: Illustrative appearance · verify with a physical sample
inspectionHelp: Tap a compartment to inspect it.
comparisonError: Save failed. The previous alternative is preserved.
comparisonUnavailable: Products are incompatible with the active catalog. Selection is disabled.
comparisonLocal: Two alternatives stored on this device. Estimates use the active catalog.
illustrativeThickness: 20 mm illustrative thickness · confirm the final specification.
offerMessage: Hello{name}! Please find offer {number} from {company}: {total}, valid for {days} days. Your 3D design: {link}
pdfDownloadedAttach: PDF downloaded. Attach it in the WhatsApp chat.
readyToSend: The offer is ready. Tap again to send it.
resetDesignHelp: Restores the default modules, materials and finishes. Client details are kept.
resetDesignDone: Configuration reset to the default design.
offlineSceneFailed: Room assets are not ready offline
finishDefaultsHint: Changes defaults. Zone and cabinet overrides stay in place.
finishOverrideHint: Cabinet overrides take priority over zone finishes.
applyAllFinishes: Apply defaults to all / clear overrides
worktopScopeHint: Worktops apply to the complete main surface or island, separately from cabinet scope.
collectionAllHint: A collection applies to all and clears overrides in one undo step.
collectionScopeHint: A collection applies to this scope. Existing cabinet overrides stay in place.
shareTooLarge: This design is too large for a link. Keep it on this device or use a PDF.
incompatibleDesign: The saved design is incompatible with this catalog or app version. Its original record is preserved. Check the catalog before continuing.
collectionSelectedHint: A collection replaces the finishes on this cabinet only.
interiorSelectCabinet: Select a cabinet to edit its interior.
interiorUnavailable: Interior editing is unavailable in this catalog.
interiorHelp: Tap a component in Interior view or choose it in the list. Height is measured from the internal floor. Fit rules are illustrative, not manufacturing specifications.
interiorPricingHelp: Moving is free. Included components are not charged twice. Removal does not reduce the package price unless the catalog specifies a credit. Clothing is decorative.
interiorResizeHelp: Size/type changes retain components and are rejected if they no longer fit. Reset the interior explicitly if needed.
interiorRegenerateWarning: Regenerating replaces custom interiors and recalculates the price. Continue? Undo can restore them.
interiorReferenceError: This interior product is incompatible with the cabinet/catalog. The previous interior and price are retained.
interiorBoundsError: The component exceeds the inside-panel bounds or supported size. The edit was rejected.
interiorOverlapError: Components or required clearances overlap. The edit was rejected.
interiorRailError: The rail needs clear space beneath it for clothing.
interiorAccessError: The drawer/basket lacks safe pull-out access. Full-width pull-outs are unsupported behind sliding fronts.
interiorMountError: Height must use a catalog mounting position.
interiorCreditError: Removal credits exceed the included interior allowance.
interiorLimitError: The limit is 32 components per cabinet and 512 per design.
interiorNoSpace: No valid mounting position is available for this product. Remove or move a component.
interiorInventoryNote: Heights are measured from the internal floor. Fit rules and prices are illustrative. Decorative contents are excluded from inventory.
updateWhenReady: Finish the current action before updating.
contextLostMessage: The 3D view paused. Your design is kept. Restore the view to continue.
